findings.claim: Generated string-key formatter for a user-declared partial class emits the template body without MessagePackSecurity handling changes, but the contractless path builds a formatter whose Deserialize relies on the generated template: when UntrustedData is used, depth is guarded via reader.Depth++ only if the template emits it. Not verified; the GeneratedFormatterCollector also passes constructorParameters as empty and relies on a public parameterless ctor, so nothing new here. However, the diff silently swallows rejected formatters: in MessagePackGenerator the model path calls Collect with reportDiagnostic: null and drops failures, with diagnostics reported only via the separate RegisterSourceOutput. If that diagnostic pipeline throws or the user suppresses it, the user-declared formatter is left with no body and no protection, but this is compile-time only.

receipt_plan.detail: Read MessagePackGenerator.cs: Collect(..., reportDiagnostic: null, ...) at the model path and the separate generatedFormatterDiagnostics pipeline; no runtime deserialization impact.
